title: Compare filling order
hints: Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: Both sums are 3, so the smaller n, 2p, comes first.
statement:
By the n+ℓ rule, which subshell fills first, 2p or 3s?

[_]{a}

choices: 2p, because it has smaller n in a tie.
3s, because it has smaller ℓ in a tie.
They have the same energy in any atom.
explanations: Equal n+ℓ is broken by n.
Smaller n is the rule for a tie.
The mnemonic does not assert degeneracy.
